activities.name: Check if user to add to AD group

text.value:
SELECT DISTINCT CRP.LOGIN_ID,CRP.FULL_NAME,AD.ID
FROM (SELECT LOGIN_ID, FULL_NAME, MAX(ACTIVE) AS ACTIVE, MAX(LAST_MODIFIED_ON_UTC) AS LAST_MODIFIED_ON_UTC FROM @{pipeline().parameters.TABLE_USER_HEADER}  GROUP BY ALL ) CRP
LEFT JOIN "RAW_PROD"."CES_ADF"."AD_USERS" AS AD
ON lower(CRP.LOGIN_ID) = lower(AD.MAIL)
LEFT JOIN "RAW_PROD"."CES_ADF"."AD_GROUP_MEMBERS" AS ADG
ON AD.ID = ADG.USER_ID
WHERE 
CRP.ACTIVE = 1
AND AD.EXTERNALUSERSTATE = 'Accepted'
AND AD.ID IS NOT NULL
AND lower(CRP.LOGIN_ID) NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT lower(MAIL) AS MAIL FROM RAW_PROD.CES_ADF.AD_GROUP_MEMBERS ADG WHERE GROUP_ID = 'b3671d93-be47-4d38-bd09-fdabcd4f6a70' AND MAIL IS NOT NULL )

activities.name: Check if new user to invite

text.value:
SELECT DISTINCT AD.ID AS USER_ID, CRP.FULL_NAME, CRP.LOGIN_ID, CRP.LAST_MODIFIED_ON_UTC
FROM (SELECT LOGIN_ID, FULL_NAME, MAX(ACTIVE) AS ACTIVE, MAX(LAST_MODIFIED_ON_UTC) AS LAST_MODIFIED_ON_UTC FROM @{pipeline().parameters.TABLE_USER_HEADER} GROUP BY ALL ) CRP
LEFT JOIN "RAW_PROD"."CES_ADF"."AD_USERS" AS AD
ON lower(CRP.LOGIN_ID) = lower(AD.MAIL)
WHERE 1=1
AND AD.ID IS NULL
AND CRP.LOGIN_ID IS NOT NULL
AND CRP.ACTIVE = 1
AND CRP.LOGIN_ID NOT IN (SELECT "user_email" FROM "CES_REF"."ADF"."AD_AUDIT_LOG" L where "operation" in ('INVITE','SEND_INVITE') AND "user_email" IS NOT NULL )
AND CRP.LAST_MODIFIED_ON_UTC > (SELECT DATEADD(DAY, @{pipeline().parameters.DAYS_DATEADD_LASTRUN} ,LAST_RUN) AS LAST_RUN FROM CES_REF.ADF.COEX_CRP_PIPELINE_LAST_RUN)

activities.name: Check if any user to remove

text.value:
SELECT DISTINCT
    AD.USER_ID AS USER_ID
    ,LOGIN_ID
    ,'b3671d93-be47-4d38-bd09-fdabcd4f6a70' AS GROUP_ID
    ,'Power BI - COEX External - Refund Point Operators' AS GROUP_NAME
    ,'REMOVE' AS OPERATION
FROM (SELECT LOGIN_ID,MAX(ACTIVE) AS ACTIVE,MAX(LAST_MODIFIED_ON_UTC) AS LAST_MODIFIED_ON_UTC FROM @{pipeline().parameters.TABLE_USER_HEADER}  GROUP BY ALL ) CRP
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM "RAW_PROD"."CES_ADF"."AD_GROUP_MEMBERS") AS AD
    ON lower(CRP.LOGIN_ID) = lower(AD.MAIL)
WHERE CRP.ACTIVE = 0
AND AD.GROUP_ID = 'b3671d93-be47-4d38-bd09-fdabcd4f6a70'
AND DATEDIFF(DAY,LAST_MODIFIED_ON_UTC,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) >= @{pipeline().parameters.DELETE_COOLDOWN}

dependsOn.activity: Check if any user to remove

text.value:
WITH CRP_USERS_INVITATION_ACCEPTED AS (
SELECT DISTINCT CRP.LOGIN_ID,CRP.FULL_NAME,AD.ID
FROM 
(SELECT LOGIN_ID, FULL_NAME, MAX(ACTIVE) AS ACTIVE, MAX(LAST_MODIFIED_ON_UTC) AS LAST_MODIFIED_ON_UTC 
FROM @{pipeline().parameters.TABLE_USER_HEADER}  
GROUP BY ALL ) CRP  
LEFT JOIN "RAW_PROD"."CES_ADF"."AD_USERS" AS AD
ON lower(CRP.LOGIN_ID) = lower(AD.MAIL)
LEFT JOIN "RAW_PROD"."CES_ADF"."AD_GROUP_MEMBERS" AS ADG
ON AD.ID = ADG.USER_ID
WHERE 
CRP.ACTIVE = 1
AND AD.EXTERNALUSERSTATE = 'Accepted'
AND AD.ID IS NOT NULL
AND CRP.LAST_MODIFIED_ON_UTC > (SELECT DATEADD(DAY, @{pipeline().parameters.DAYS_DATEADD_LASTRUN},LAST_RUN) AS LAST_RUN FROM CES_REF.ADF.COEX_CRP_PIPELINE_LAST_RUN)  
), USERS_IN_AD_GROUP AS (

SELECT DISTINCT ADG.MAIL AS LOGIN_ID 
FROM RAW_PROD.CES_ADF.AD_USERS AD
  LEFT JOIN RAW_PROD.CES_ADF.AD_GROUP_MEMBERS AS ADG
    ON AD.ID = ADG.USER_ID 
    where ADG.GROUP_ID = 'b3671d93-be47-4d38-bd09-fdabcd4f6a70' 
), AUDIT_LOG AS (

select distinct "user_email" AS LOGIN_ID 
from CES_REF.ADF.AD_AUDIT_LOG 
where "operation" = 'SEND_CRP_REPORT_LINK' 

), AUDIT_LOG_AD_ADD AS (  

select distinct "user_email" AS LOGIN_ID 
from CES_REF.ADF.AD_AUDIT_LOG 
where "operation" = 'ADD_TO_CRP_GROUP' AND "execution_datetime" < DATEADD(hour, -1, CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', 'Australia/Sydney', SYSDATE()))


), USERS_IN_RLS AS (

SELECT DISTINCT LOGIN_ID 
FROM @{pipeline().parameters.RLS_TABLE}  
WHERE TAXONOMY = 'CRP' 
AND MULTI_SCHEME_ID = 10000

)

SELECT IA.LOGIN_ID 
FROM CRP_USERS_INVITATION_ACCEPTED IA 
LEFT JOIN USERS_IN_AD_GROUP AD
ON UPPER(IA.LOGIN_ID) = UPPER(AD.LOGIN_ID) 
LEFT JOIN USERS_IN_RLS RLS
ON UPPER(IA.LOGIN_ID) = UPPER(RLS.LOGIN_ID) 
LEFT JOIN AUDIT_LOG AL
ON UPPER(IA.LOGIN_ID) = UPPER(AL.LOGIN_ID) 
LEFT JOIN AUDIT_LOG_AD_ADD ADL
ON UPPER(IA.LOGIN_ID) = UPPER(ADL.LOGIN_ID) 
WHERE RLS.LOGIN_ID IS NOT NULL AND ADL.LOGIN_ID IS NOT NULL AND AL.LOGIN_ID IS NULL
